# A USD purchase entered with the signs the wrong way round.
#
# As written, the USD split is negative — currency leaving an account that
# never held it — so it establishes no cost basis, and the transaction is
# editable. Correcting the signs makes it a purchase, and the correction
# reuses the same splits rather than creating new ones: splits are matched by
# account, so the guid does not change.
#
# What the corrected version must produce: a basis with a balance for the 100.00 USD
# that has now arrived. Skipping any split that existed before the edit left
# it `none recorded`, over a message saying this tool never wrote it.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_update_strategy_respects_cost_basis.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank:USD
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"

2026-01-10 * "Buy 100 USD at 1.35"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank:USD -100.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.35"
		value: "-135.00"
	Assets:Bank 135.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		share_price: "1"
		value: "135.00"
